title: Blerp
description: Blerp’s Minecraft mod turns viewer support into 500+ live in-game actions, letting your audience spawn mobs, drop traps, change player stats, scramble inventory, build structures, and reshape the world in real time! Works with all streaming platforms.
body:
Blerp brings your audience directly into your Minecraft world. Turn viewer support into real-time chaos, surprises, rewards, and challenges that happen live while you play.

With 500+ Minecraft actions, viewers can:

- Spawn mobs
- Give or remove items
- Teleport players
- Change health, hunger, XP, weather, time, and other gameplay conditions
- Set traps
- Place structures
- Trigger explosions, cages, mob swarms, inventory changes, and other chaotic Minecraft moments

Minecraft actions can also be combined with other Blerp features, including sounds, TTS, videos, and overlays, to build bigger stream moments around what happens in-game.

Blerp works with Twitch, Kick, YouTube, and many other streaming platforms.

To use this mod, you’ll need to set up your Minecraft actions on Blerp’s website and connect the mod to Blerp.
